notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
description:
Cast Quirion Sentinel for {G}, triggering Sporemound and Cloudstone Curio.
Quirion Sentinel triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Sporemound's trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Quirion Sentinel to your hand.
Repeat.
